description: An audacious comedic fable about sex, marriage, and the absurdities of social convention, WICKER tells the wholly original love story of an ostracized fisherwoman (Olivia Colman) who commissions a husband to be made by the local basketmaker (Peter Dinklage). author: IGN
description: We played about 10 hours of the revamped multiplayer in the Gears of War: E-Day preview beta. And while it feels extremely familiar to play, there are some refreshing gameplay changes that are subtle yet meaningful. The refined control scheme shined in the PvP Versus and the new Horde Siege modes, the latter of which has the potential to make Gears E-Day truly stand out. We dig deep into all the details from our hands-on experience and breakdown Horde Siege.
title: Gears of War: E-Day Multiplayer – The First Preview

author: IGN
description: We’re definitely excited for Insomniac’s spin on Wolverine, but we’re trying to keep expectations in check. On a strictly mechanical level, will a linear hack-and-slash be as much fun moment-to-moment as an open-world web-swinging simulator? Marvel’s Spider-Man and Spider-Man: Miles Morales and Spider-Man 2 are all a great time even when you’re not doing anything particularly super-heroic, but in Wolverine’s case, it’s a linear experience focused primarily on combat. Will that have as much lasting appeal? Meanwhile, Spider-Man’s friendly neighborhood all-ages appeal and T-rating might have something to do with the first installment being Sony’s best-selling PS4 game, but Wolverine’s M-rating and focus on gruesome combat might not do it any favors this holiday shopping season. Meanwhile, this game might have gotten a bit more attention two years ago, when Deadpool and Wolverine was in theaters, rather than coming out in the wake of Spider-Man: Brand New Day. In any case, we’re excited,
title: Can Wolverine Reach The Same Heights as Insomniac's Spider-Man Games? - Beyond Clips

author: IGN
description:
We've been hands-on with Star Wars: Galactic Racer's fast and furious roguelike campaign, and it's looking a game changer for racing games. Across four hours of play we competed across four different planets, crafting our speeder to take on each world's unique challenges and status effects. But while all the buildcraft offered by the campaign's roguelike design is fascinatingly implemented, what really impressed us is how dangerous racing on these sci-fi tracks feels. In a galaxy far, far away, motorsport takes place at vastly higher speeds in much deadlier vehicles across far more dangerous terrain. If it was going to feel exactly right, of course developer Fuse Games had to dial up the fear. 

#ign #gaming
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Surprised Me With the Dangerous Depth of Its Roguelike Campaign

Here's your look at the Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos announcement trailer for this upcoming remaster of the classic sequel to Croc: Legend of the Gobbos. Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos will feature enhanced visuals, quality-of-life improvements, and over 40 levels of expanded 3D platforming, including new traversal mechanics like triple jumping, vehicles, and aerial gameplay. The remaster will also introduce the 'Croc2pedia,' an in-game digital museum featuring never-before-seen development materials, cut content, and developer interviews. 

In Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos, Croc sets off for the mainland in search of his long-lost parents. However, his journey becomes a showdown as his arch-nemesis, Baron Dante, is resurrected by the Dantinis and vows revenge. author: IGN
description: The Defiant is a story-driven singleplayer shooter from developer Hangzhou Hoothanes Entertainment that's set to explore the prolonged and devastating Second Sino-Japanese War from the perspective of multiple Chinese soldiers. After getting hands-on with it at a recent BiliBili: First Look event in Shanghai, my first impression of The Defiant is that it’s spotlighting a setting that feels unexplored for the World War II genre, in a singleplayer-focussed style that’s a welcome throwback to a bygone era of story-driven shooters. Previewed by Tristan Ogilvie.
title: The Defiant is a Story-Driven Shooter that Explores a Rarely Seen Side of WW2 | IGN Preview
